sourceVerification: All runtime JavaScript files in the pinned source archive exactly match the installed npm jsonwebtoken 9.0.3 fixture.

dependencies.lodash helpers: native validation and direct callback completion

changes: Require finite NumericDate claims and time options; honor zero timestamps and maxAge.
Use canonical compact validation and algorithm/key checks from vjws/vjwa.
Complete callbacks once, isolate resolver headers, snapshot options before asynchronous key resolution.
Use native secret import directly for ordinary HMAC keys; retain asymmetric PEM detection.
Bound immutable public PEM caching to 16 entries and 16 KiB each; cache immutable key metadata weakly; never cache private key strings, secrets or mutable buffers.
Always encode object JSON as UTF-8; verify UTF-8 even when typ is absent.
Require explicit none algorithm with no key; disallow asymmetric validation bypass and explicit algorithm/header disagreement.
Reject top-level payload toJSON methods and boxed option primitives; snapshot own properties and preserve prototype keys as data.
Use native Error subclasses so Bun diagnostic stacks include the correct name and message.
Validate issuer/algorithm lists without sparse-array bypasses and make RegExp audience matching deterministic.
upstreamTestAdaptations: Nine upstream TODO expectations for non-finite iat, exp and nbf now require rejection, retaining each input.
Object JSON binary-encoding test decodes UTF-8; supplied-key none signing test now requires an error.
Enable the upstream skipped unsigned callback signing case. Node: 512 pass; Bun: 509 pass, 3 restricted RSA-PSS import tests pending.
On Bun only, use native Node to re-encode the same two upstream explicit-parameter EC public points as named-curve SPKI for both baseline and VPM; assertions and signing keys remain unchanged.
Route internal asymmetric validator tests to VPM keys.validate, preserving the upstream helper convention that missing algorithm/key is a no-op.
Run pinned Mocha/Chai/Sinon tools in an isolated development fixture; independent upstream JWS constructs tokens for both implementations.
